title: ICIG hinted to Brown that humans are not in charge

tellings.quote: the ICIG did it >> with me personally I I want to respect them but the ICI did it with me yes

plain: The office of the Intelligence Community Inspector General, which investigates complaints inside the US spy agencies, hinted to him that humans are not the ones in charge. That is what Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who calls himself a whistleblower, tells Michels. He says he wants to respect the office, but that "the ICIG did it with me," personally. If true, an official watchdog would be quietly signalling that some other power is in control.
